notes.title: Summary of updates (up to v1.3.0)
notes.content:
In response to the various comments from users of the trial version and the full version, we have made a series of updates from the perspective of QoL Quality of Life to enhance playability and understanding of the game system, and to make it more comfortable.

We hope you will enjoy our new PRG! Burn Your Soul!!

[h3]Update History[/h3]
v1.1.0
　QoL: Added Language switching on the options screen.
　Qol: Added Arts suggestion during battles (at the bottom of the ring command)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952110/7790724a91d78577f5c92c1b4d240278c28be845.png[/img]

v1.1.1
　QoL: Added the ability to select soul bits with the space key during battle

v1.1.2
　QoL: Adjusted the opacity of the background of the window

v1.2.0
　QoL: Added TIPS video in tutorial
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952110/e9b2f5c5fcdd03614452439d6a8801506dbcbdd1.png[/img]

v1.2.1
　QoL: Added KARMA reward acquisition notice
　Balance: Adjustment of encounter rate in the beginning of the game
　Balance: Adjustment of the amount of soul fragments obtained from some dominators
　Balance: Adjustment of HP of some dominators
　
v1.2.2
　QoL: Expanded space key support
　QoL: Added tutorial drones
　QoL: Adjusted the timing of opening TUTORIALS information
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952110/4a036da8b50b6b7140b5f5712dfebd291a46ef09.png[/img]

v1.3.0
　QoL: Display Soulbit and Arts information during battle.
　Other minor bugs have been addressed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952110/0a011033e182ea7d70e97380c575e630acfe175f.png[/img].

notes.title: 7/25/2023(JST) SOULVARS Update Notice!
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of SOULVARS!
Referring your comments, we have released following updates in the patch distributed today.

[u][b]■Addition of tutorial drones[/b][/u].
We have added tutorial drones in various locations to give you tips.

[b][u]■Addition of notices when obtaining KARMA rewards[/u][/b].
A notification mark will now appear in MENU > DDO NaviMenu > KARMA when there is a KARMA that has not yet acquired a reward.

[b][u]■Changing rules for opening tutorial items[/u][/b].
The rules for opening items in MENU > DDO NaviMenu > TUTORIAL have been revised so that each item can be viewed from the beginning.

[b][u]■Improvement of using the space key[/u][/b].
The space key, which was previously only used to make selections during battles, can now be used to make decisions in other operations as well.

[b][u]■Adjustment of some balance[/u][/b].
Balance adjustments have been made to some strong enemies and encounter rates.

[b][u]■Fixed other problems including text[/u][/b].
The problem of text misalignment during translation has been fixed.

We hope you continue to enjoy SOULVARS, which is now easier to play!
